Without that sentence, the wording is compatible with a naive implementation that labels directly from the agent string, which is the textbook Prometheus label-injection/cardinality-explosion anti-pattern -- every other genuinely code-closed bounded-label counter in docs/observability-conventions.md (yuzu_nvd_sync_failures_total{reason}, yuzu_server_quarantine_gate_total{outcome}, yuzu_server_quarantine_reapply_total{result}) states its backing enum/array explicitly; this one does not.
